svg.title: SN 441011 Type 13 socket-outlet (female), mating face, earth hole down
svg.desc: Schematic front view with the earth hole down; the hexagonal recess outline follows photographs and is not dimensioned. Neutral hole left, line hole right, earth hole between them and slightly lower. Rings are female contacts. Proportions follow 19 mm between the line and neutral holes and a 5 mm earth offset; the recess outline is schematic.
